t1676.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Khalid ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid ibn al-Zubayr al-Thaqafi, unknown, who sent a narration from 'Umar. Ibn 'Asakir said al-Bukhari and his followers made him other than the previous one, but in my view they are one.

t2008.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Zirr ibn Ḥubaysh ibn Ḥubāsha al-Asadī al-Kūfī, Abū Maryam, as trustworthy, eminent, and a mukhaḍram; he died in 81, 82, or 83 at the age of 127.
as: Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
He was reliable and transmitted many hadiths.
كان زر من أعرب الناس، وكان عبد الله يسأله عن العربية.
Zirr spoke some of the purest Arabic, and ʿAbd Allāh asked him about Arabic.
عاصم, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
كان من أعرب الناس وكان ابن مسعود يسأله عن العربية.
He spoke some of the purest Arabic, and Ibn Masʿūd asked him about Arabic.
He was knowledgeable about the Qurʾan, a reciter and a virtuous man.
He was virtuous and knowledgeable about the Qurʾan.
كان زر بن حبيش أعرب الناس وكان عبد الله يسأله عن العربية.
Zirr had the purest speech, and ʿAbd Allāh asked him about Arabic.
He was reliable and transmitted many hadiths.

t2619.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Sulaymān ibn Yasār al-Hilālī al-Madanī, client of Maymūna and it is said of Umm Salama, as trustworthy and virtuous, one of the seven jurists, of the leading third generation; he died after 100, or it is said before.
as: He was one of the scholars.
وسليمان بن يسار في مشيخة جلة سواهم من نظرائهم أهل فقه وصلاح وفضل
Sulaymān ibn Yasār was among the eminent Medinan elders of learning, uprightness and merit whose opinions were accepted.
الحسن بن محمد بن الحنفية, quoted by al-Mizzī
سليمان بن يسار عندنا افهم من سعيد بن المسيب
We consider Sulaymān ibn Yasār more discerning than Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyib.
Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyib, quoted by al-Mizzī
اذهب إلى سليمان بن يسار فإنه أعلم من بقي اليوم
Go to Sulaymān ibn Yasār. He is the most learned of those alive today.
كان سليمان بن يسار من علماء الناس بعد سعيد بن المسيب، وكان كثيرا ما يوافق سعيدا، وكان سعيد لايجترأ عليه
Sulaymān was one of the leading scholars after Saʿīd. He often agreed with Saʿīd, and Saʿīd did not presume against him.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
Abū Zurʿah al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
Reliable, trustworthy, of merit and devoted to worship.
وكان ثقة عالما رفيعا فقيها كثير الحديث
He was a reliable and eminent scholar, a jurist with many hadith.
مصعب بن عثمان, quoted by al-Mizzī
كان سليمان بن يسار من أحسن الناس وجها
Sulaymān was among the handsomest people.
الحسن بن محمد بن علي, quoted by Ibn Saʿd
كان سليمان بن يسار أفهم من سعيد بن المسيب
Sulaymān ibn Yasār was more discerning than Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyib.
وكان ثقة عاليا رفيعا فقيها كثير الحديث
He was reliable, of high standing, and a jurist who transmitted many hadith.

t4341.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Muʿādh ibn Muʿādh al-ʿAnbarī, Abū ʿAmr al-Baṣrī, as trustworthy and a memorizer, of the tenth generation, who died in the year 37 (hundreds omitted); Ibn Maʿīn preferred his brother al-Muthannā over him.
as: رجح بن معين أخاه المثنى عليه
Ibn Maʿīn preferred his brother al-Muthannā over him.
Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
كان يحفظ نحو عشرة آلاف، أحاديث أشعث بمسائله المعقدة وأحاديث معتمر، وأحاديث خالد، ورأيته يدرس حديث سفيان على ابنه، وكان فصيحا

He memorized about ten thousand, including the hadiths of Ashʿath with their difficult questions and those of Muʿtamir and Khālid. Abū Dāwūd saw him review Sufyān’s hadiths with his son and called him eloquent.
Ibn Ḥibbān listed him among the trustworthy transmitters.
